title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_12633)
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS IS_12633) covers Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_12633). This Indian Standard was adopted by the the draft finalized by the Water Conductor Systems Sectional Committee had been approved by the Civil Engineering Division Council. The pressure tunnel is a part of water conductor system and hence the filling and emptying is linked with overall planning of filling and emptying of the water conductor system. The schedule of first fiUing and emptying of tunnel for a project shall be prepared and discussed among design and field engineers in detail before commencement of operation. marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
